note: The entry follows Holmgren's 1910 original description (soldier and worker), published as Eutermes maximus n. sp. The original is a library OCR text of a BHL scan (Zenodo/Plazi mirror); the German original description was read line by line; figures that the OCR scrambled beyond confirmation are not listed.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 4.5—5 mm, head length 1.9—2.05 mm (mode 1.95—2 mm), head width 1.15—1.3 mm (mean 1.25 mm, 10 specimens measured). Very similar to Eutermes major but distinctly larger. Head glossy dark brown, the nasus paler; pronotum brown; the rest of the body rusty brown to rusty yellow. Head with bristles at the base of the nasus, on the vertex and at the sides; abdominal tergites smooth with only one row of marginal bristles. Head broadly oval, the nasus thick and rather long; frontal outline with a distinct elevation at the base of the nasus. Antennae 14-segmented: segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 equal to segment 3; segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum a rather deep saddle, anterior margin distinctly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 5.5—6 mm, head length 1.54 mm. Head plate and transverse band brown; cephalic sutures, a small spot at the extension of the sagittal suture, clypeus, genae, antennae and mouthparts white to white-yellow; the rest of the body white-yellow. Head with extremely fine hairs; abdominal tergites finely hairy, often with one indistinct row of marginal bristles. Head broadly oval; cephalic sutures open and of uniform width; fontanelle ill-defined, elongate-triangular; clypeus far shorter than half its width. Antennae 15-segmented: segment 3 equal to segment 2; segment 4 slightly shorter but thicker; segment 5 globular. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin distinctly concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Chaquimayo, Peru. Figure 40 of the original shows the soldier head in dorsal and lateral view.
